WEB_ORIGIN.description: Must match your app's Heroku URL — update after deploy.

PUBLIC_BASE_URL.description: Must match your app's Heroku URL — update after deploy.

MOCK_MODE.description: Mock *authentication* also needs ALLOW_INSECURE_MOCK_AUTH=true and is refused when NODE_ENV=production, because that branch accepts a caller-supplied identity.

ALLOW_INSECURE_MOCK_AUTH.description: Leave false in any shared environment.

DEV_EMAIL.description: Developer console login. Must be set to a non-default value before enabling the console in production.

DEV_PASSWORD.description: Developer console password. Must be set to a non-default value before enabling the console in production.

DEV_ROUTES_ENABLED.description: /api/v1/dev is not mounted in production unless this is exactly 'true'.
